# Teams feasibility fixtures

`connector-private.pem` is a non-secret RSA test key copied from the
MIT-licensed `jsonwebtoken` 11.0.0 test suite. It exists only to create a
deterministic RS256 token inside the hermetic test. It must never be used
outside tests.

`connector-openid.json` and `connector-jwks.json` are frozen representative
Bot Connector wire documents. The public RSA values in the JWKS correspond to
the test-only private key. The verifier must deserialize these bytes rather
than deriving its verification key from the private key.

## Teams SDK v2.1.1 reference

The compatibility target is Microsoft's `teams.ts` release `v2.1.1`, commit
`79ed749cb65c7f14bb9b1f94b8cfdc7b9c5a5b81`.

`sdk-v2.1.1-personal-message.json` is a synthetic personal-chat Activity written
for Dione. It follows the pinned SDK's [base Activity fields][activity] and
[message fields][message]. Its names, IDs, tenant, text, and timestamps are test
values. It is neither a production capture nor output generated by the SDK.
The SDK packages and test suite are not executed by this fixture test.

`sdk_v2_1_1_personal_message_retains_current_authentication_and_reply_contract`
signs separate classic Connector claims with the existing test key, authenticates
the Activity through Dione, checks tenant and conversation denial controls, and
asserts Dione's exact current reply URL and JSON. This protects existing behavior;
it does not establish equivalence to the SDK's send, reply, or quote helpers.
Those operations have their own later compatibility slice.

The fixture includes optional SDK fields that Dione currently discards. Their
presence tests tolerance of additional message data, not preservation of that
data. The [compatibility inventory](../../../docs/design/teams-sdk-compatibility.md)
records the scope and issue for each planned behavior.

[activity]: https://github.com/microsoft/teams.ts/blob/79ed749cb65c7f14bb9b1f94b8cfdc7b9c5a5b81/packages/api/src/activities/activity.ts
[message]: https://github.com/microsoft/teams.ts/blob/79ed749cb65c7f14bb9b1f94b8cfdc7b9c5a5b81/packages/api/src/activities/message/message.ts
